news.t: Jack Grealish misses Everton-Newcastle due to 'breach of club discipline'
news.desc: Jack Grealish was made unavailable for Everton's Carabao Cup round of 16 match against Newcastle on Thursday due to what the club called a "breach of club discipline."

news.t: Everton beat Newcastle to set up Carabao quarters match with Fleetwood
news.desc: Everton set up a Carabao Cup quarterfinal against League Two Fleetwood as they eased to a 3-1 win over Newcastle United on Thursday.

news.t: Gianluigi Donnarumma not at-risk from Gerónimo Rulli - Man City boss
news.desc: Gianluigi Donnarumma's place in goal for Manchester City is not under threat from penalty hero Gerónimo Rulli, Enzo Maresca confirmed.

news.t: Giorgi Mamardashvili after Liverpool heroics: Penalty notes 'were wrong'
news.desc: Giorgi Mamardashvili has said that the research notes given to him before Liverpool's penalty shootout win against Chelsea were incorrect.
